## Problem and change

Describe the concrete trigger, current behavior and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Separate unit/API tests, native integration,
packet tests and hardware evidence. Do not include private environment material.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe API, ownership, native Kube-OVN compatibility, upgrade/rollback and security
impacts, or state that there are none. Call out any migration or recovery steps.

- [ ] I reviewed the contribution guidance and the experimental support scope.
- [ ] Documentation/examples match the final behavior.
- [ ] The patch and evidence contain no credentials or private environment details.
- [ ] Relevant tests passed, or remaining limitations are explicitly described.
- [ ] Third-party code and dependencies retain their required license notices.
